title: Computations of higher elliptic units in optimal settings
summary: In this paper we present a simplified form of a conjecture on the construction of generalised elliptic units above number fields with exactly one complex place. They are conjectural algebraic numbers which are obtained as special values of higher elliptic Gamma functions. These functions form a collection of multivariate meromorphic functions which were studied in the late 1990s and early 2000s in mathematical physics.
